comment: The table of the fort checker: the rule of D3.14 that the first level that the result of a cast
marks `mut` keeps each pointer place of the source with its exact type, with the exemption of an
argument of an `extern fn` and a work limit (src/fort/check.ft: check_pointer_places,
first_hidden, part_at and check_call; src/fort/types.ft: type_is_pointer_place and the pointer
count of type_layout_struct). Each row breaks one rule of that walk. The stages are the cast
corpus of test/lang, whose fail tests pin the message, the byte and the level of each place,
and the checker suite, which pins the count and the position of each report. The table runs in
the VM: pass a --runner that runs tools/vm run in one slot and then syncs, as
notes/environment.md says. The md5 guard reads the product compiler that the build links. Put
a row that an earlier run caught first, because the first round of a run in the VM can read
stale (notes/testing.md). The checker suite runs with --timeout 120: the rows D3.14-keep-memo
and D3.14-keep-modulo change the time of the walk and not its answer, and the shapes of 128 to
the power 6 owners in check_expr_test.ft then pass the timeout.
build: sleep 2 && touch src/fort/check.ft src/fort/types.ft && ninja -C build/Linux/debug fort

stages.name: the cast corpus
stages.command: python3 test/lang/run_tests.py --fort build/Linux/debug/fort --std-dir build/Linux/debug/std -j 4 fail/casts/ run/casts/

stages.name: the checker suite
stages.command: python3 test/lang/run_tests.py --root test/fort --fort build/Linux/debug/fort --std-dir build/Linux/debug/std --timeout 120 -j 4 check_expr_test session_test

the error names another level
a span source keeps no owner place
an argument of an `extern fn` gets no exemption
the rule reads a level with no layout or in error
